verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can share spaces and collaborate: collaborators need no email or subscription, owners grant access, sync runs peer-to-peer or self-hosted, and Pinned items are visible to everyone in a shared Channel. Two older community comments said collaboration and sharing were not yet available, which reads as a past state rather than a concrete contradiction of current docs, but it lowers confidence. missing for 10: evidence of simultaneous co-editing and conflict-free merging so collaborators don't overwrite each other's changes, permission/role details, independent hands-on corroboration of current shared editing.
